cases.input: An app automatically bookmarks a recommendation through the same handler as the bookmark button. The dashboard calls every event a user bookmark click. There is no approved schema distinction documented.
required: Separate action origin from successful execution.
Request the approved contract for automatic versus intentional actions.
Do not interpret automatic actions as intentional engagement.
reject: Invent a new production event field without approval.
Claim higher user engagement from these counts.

cases.input: A card shows a tutorial thumbnail but its primary action opens a workshop page. The telemetry helper labels every primary action with the tutorial object's ID.
required: Trace the actual action destination through the caller and helper.
Validate metadata against the destination contract rather than the visual label.
reject: Assume successful emission means the event is semantically correct.

cases.input: A compact panel has refresh enabled but no body node. Telemetry registration uses only the body node. A unit test mocks the emitter and passes.
required: Trace host registration and lifetime in the actual compact layout.
Distinguish mocked contract assertions from real local emission.
Verify the supported registration/emitter path without fabricated production DOM.
reject: Claim ingestion correctness from the mocked test.

cases.input: Two intentional user activations each emit an event. A transport retry resends the first event. A proposed fix drops all events of that type after the first.
required: Distinguish legitimate second actions from retry duplication.
reject: Approve global deduplication by event type.

cases.input: Real local emission and a network request are observed, but downstream analytics access is denied. A stakeholder asks whether the new counts prove adoption improved.
required: Report the available local-emission and transport evidence.
State that ingestion and population completeness remain unverified.
Do not infer adoption or causal improvement from an instrumentation change.
reject: Retry or bypass authentication without authorization.
Report inaccessible metrics as zero or successful.
